problem: A data set has a mean $\overset{¯}{x}=-100$ and an unknown standard deviation. An observation of the data set has the value $x=-83$ and $z$-score $z=1.7.$ Find the standard deviation of the data set.
worked_solution:
To compute the value of an observation $x$ which yields a given $z$-score in a data set with mean $\overset{―}{x}$ and standard deviation $\sigma ,$ we can use the following formula:

$$
x=\overset{―}{x}+z\cdot \sigma 
$$

Substituting $x=-83,$ $\overset{¯}{x}=-100,$ and $z=1.7$ into the formula and solving for $\sigma ,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =\overset{―}{x}+z\cdot \sigma  \\ -83 & =-100+1.7\cdot \sigma  \\ 17 & =1.7\cdot \sigma  \\ \sigma  & =10.\end{aligned}
$$
